main.description: Accept a pending ownership transfer, becoming the group's owner. Callable only by the DID named as the proposed new owner in the pending proposal — the authenticated request proves they still control that DID. On success the previous owner is demoted to admin, the caller is promoted to owner atomically, and the pending proposal is cleared.

repo.description: The handle or DID of the target group. Omit when supplied via the querystring.

previousOwner.description: The DID demoted from owner to admin. Present whenever the group had an owner before the transfer, which is the normal case; omitted only in the degenerate case of a group with no prior owner.

errors.name: ApiKeyNotPermitted
errors.description: The request was authenticated with an API key. Accepting ownership requires a DID-authenticated JWT, which proves live control of the recipient DID.

errors.name: UnknownGroup
errors.description: The repo does not resolve to a managed group.

errors.name: NoPendingTransfer
errors.description: There is no live pending transfer to accept (never proposed, already resolved, or expired).

errors.name: NotProposedOwner
errors.description: The caller is not the DID named as the proposed new owner.
